title: 第十一章 七个小矮子濯垢泉第十二章 金乌遗址师兄妹
slug: 西游从蜈蚣精到百目真君
content_zh:
吴耀驾着清风一路南行，约莫飞了半个时辰。
前方山势渐渐低缓下来，群山环抱之间露出一处幽深的山谷。
谷中雾气缭绕，隐约可见一片竹林掩映的洞府，洞口上方垂着七道不同颜色的丝幔，赤橙黄绿青蓝紫，在风中轻轻摇曳。
洞前有一条清澈见底的山溪蜿蜒流过，溪水潺潺，水面上漂着几片粉色的桃花瓣。
他在谷口降下遁光，收了法衣上的金光，改为步行往里走。
盘丝洞是七个蜘蛛精的洞府。
他是来讨要蛛毒的是客，直接驾着遁光落到人家洞府门前未免失礼。
山谷中林木茂密，一条碎石铺就的小径蜿蜒通向竹林深处。
吴耀走得不快，一边走一边打量着四周的景致。
这盘丝洞所在的山谷灵气颇为充沛，虽比不上黄花山那般得天独厚，但也算一处不错的修炼之地。
谷中花草繁茂，蜂蝶成群，空气里弥漫着一股淡淡的花蜜香甜。
正走着，前方忽然窜出几道矮小的身影，一字排开拦在了路中间。
吴耀脚步一顿，低头看去。
那是七个小人，个头最高的也不过二尺五六寸，连三尺都不到，站在路上就像七根矮木桩。
身形虽小，却一个个长得奇形怪状，打扮也各有不同。
领头的一个又矮又胖，圆滚滚的像个蜜罐子，身上裹着一件黄黑相间的短褂。
旁边一个瘦高个，穿着一身青灰色的紧身衣，尖嘴猴腮，两只眼睛又大又凸。
还有一个浑身毛茸茸的，花花绿绿的短袍上满是细密的绒毛，看着就让人想打喷嚏。
其他几个也是各有各的古怪，有的背后长着两对透明的薄翅。
有的胳膊细得像两根枯枝，有的脸上覆着一层油亮亮的蜡黄色硬壳。

七个站在一起，活像七个没长大的孩童。
但身上却都有妖气波动，显然也是修炼有成的妖怪，只是修为尚浅，最多不过炼气化神的层次。
“站住！”领头那个圆滚滚的小人尖声喝道，声音又细又尖，像是蜜蜂振翅的嗡嗡声。
“你是什么人？这里是盘丝洞的地界，闲杂人等不得擅入！”
吴耀低头看着这七个小人，心中忽然一动。
七个，七个矮小的妖怪。
盘丝洞，蜘蛛精。
这几个关键词凑在一起，他很快便想起了原著中的一段记载。
盘丝洞的七个蜘蛛精确实收了七个干儿子。
分别是一只蜜蜂、一只蚂蜂、一只虫卢蜂、一只班毛、一只牛蜢、一只抹蜡和一只蜻蜓。
这七个义子都是些不成气候的小虫小豸，因机缘巧合得了些灵智。
被七个蜘蛛精收在膝下当干儿子养着，平日里就在盘丝洞附近跑腿打杂。
眼前这七个，相貌古怪，身形矮小，身上又都带着虫类妖气，跟原著里的描述一一对得上。
那个圆滚滚黄黑相间的多半就是蜜蜂，尖嘴猴腮的那个是蚂蜂。
浑身绒毛的是班毛，背后有翅膀的想必是蜻蜓，脸上覆蜡黄色硬壳的自然就是抹蜡了。
吴耀心里有了数，也不跟这几个小妖计较，直接从怀中取出那枚蛛形令牌，亮在他们面前。
令牌不大，通体乌黑，形如一只八足舒张的蜘蛛，背面刻着一个古朴的“蛛”字。
这是红衣女子当日亲手交给他的盘丝洞信物，说是凭此令牌可以在盘丝洞畅通无阻。
果然，七个小人一看到这枚令牌，脸色齐齐一变。
领头的那个圆滚滚凑上前来，踮起脚尖仔细端详了一番。

确认是真物无误后，态度立刻来了个一百八十度的大转弯，脸上的警惕和凶悍瞬间换成了谄媚的笑容。
content_en:
Wu Yao rode Qingfeng all the way south, flying for about half an hour.
The mountains ahead gradually slow down, revealing a deep valley surrounded by mountains.
The mist is lingering in the valley, and a cave hidden by a bamboo forest can be vaguely seen. Above the entrance of the cave hangs seven silk curtains of different colors, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple, swaying gently in the wind.
There is a crystal clear mountain stream winding in front of the cave, with gurgling water and a few pink peach petals floating on the water.
He lowered his escape light at the mouth of the valley, took away the golden light on his cassock, and walked inside instead.
Pansi Cave is the cave of seven spider spirits.
He was a guest here to ask for spider poison, so it would be rude to drive the light directly to the door of his cave.
The valley is densely forested, and a gravel path winds into the depths of the bamboo forest.
Wu Yao walked slowly, looking at the surrounding scenery as he walked.
The valley where Pansi Cave is located is quite rich in spiritual energy. Although it is not as unique as Huanghua Mountain, it is still a good place for cultivation.
The flowers and plants in the valley are luxuriant, there are swarms of bees and butterflies, and the air is filled with a faint sweet fragrance of nectar.
As they were walking, several short figures suddenly appeared in front of them and lined up in the middle of the road.
Wu Yao paused and looked down.
They were seven little people, the tallest of whom was only two feet five or six inches, not even three feet tall. They looked like seven short wooden stakes standing on the road.
Although they are small in stature, they all have strange shapes and are dressed in different ways.
The leader was short, fat, round like a honey pot, and wrapped in a yellow and black short coat.
Next to him was a tall and thin man, wearing a blue-gray tights, with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks, and two big and bulging eyes.
There is also a furry man with a colorful short robe covered with fine fluff, which makes people want to sneeze just looking at it.
The others are also weird in their own way, and some have two pairs of transparent thin wings on their backs.
Some arms were as thin as two dead branches, and some faces were covered with a shiny waxy hard shell.
The seven standing together look like seven children who have not grown up.
But there are demonic energy fluctuations all over his body. He is obviously a demon who has successfully cultivated, but his cultivation level is still shallow, at most, it is only at the level of refining qi and becoming a god.
"Stop!" the chubby little man in the lead screamed, his voice thin and sharp, like the buzzing of a bee's wings.
"Who are you? This is the boundary of Pansi Cave. No one can enter without permission!"
Wu Yao looked down at the seven villains, and his heart suddenly moved.
Seven, seven little monsters.
Pansi Cave, Spider Spirit.
Putting these keywords together, he quickly remembered a record in the original work.
The seven spider spirits in Pansi Cave did indeed adopt seven godsons.
They are a bee, an ant, a bee, a bee, a cowhopper, a wax and a dragonfly.
These seven adopted sons were all insignificant little insects who gained some intelligence by chance.
He was taken under the lap of seven spider spirits and raised as a godson. On weekdays, he ran errands and did odd jobs near Pansi Cave.
The seven in front of me have strange looks, short statures, and all have insect-like demonic auras about them. They match the descriptions in the original book.
The round yellow and black one is probably a bee, and the one with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks is an ant.
The ones with fluffy bodies are Ban Mao, the ones with wings on the back must be dragonflies, and the ones with waxy hard shells on their faces are naturally waxed.
Wu Yao knew it in his mind and didn't care about these little demons. He took out the spider-shaped token from his arms and showed it in front of them.
The token is small, completely black, shaped like a spider with eight legs spread out, and has a simple word "spider" engraved on the back.
This is the Pansi Cave token that the woman in red gave him personally that day, saying that with this token, he can travel unimpeded in Pansi Cave.
Sure enough, when the seven villains saw this token, their expressions all changed.
The leader, Yuan Guanguan, came forward and stood on tiptoes to take a closer look.After a while.
After confirming that it was the real thing, his attitude immediately changed 180 degrees, and the vigilance and fierceness on his face were instantly replaced by a flattering smile.
